mapper.select: SELECT member.user_id, user.username, user.display_name, member.member_role, CASE member.member_role WHEN 'RESIDENT' THEN '居民' WHEN 'METER_READER' THEN '抄表员' WHEN 'ADMIN' THEN '管理员' END AS member_role_name, member.last_read_message_id, member.last_read_at, member.joined_at, member.left_at, CASE WHEN member.left_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS active FROM chat_conversation_member AS member INNER JOIN sys_user AS user ON user.id = member.user_id WHERE member.conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY active DESC, member.joined_at ASC, member.user_id ASC
